name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
value: US ~7,500 cases since 2025; PAHO ruling due
summary: PAHO ruling on whether the US has lost measles elimination is expected from 16 Nov; ~7,500 US cases since 2025
state: PAHO's verification commission met in closed session through 13 Nov to review US measles elimination status, held since 2000; PAHO's director makes the final call, expected to be made public early in the week of 16 Nov (Reuters via News Tribune, 11 Nov). Nearly 7,500 US cases and 11 deaths have been reported since early 2025, and states have reported their first measles deaths in decades (Healio, 9 Nov). Searches on 16 Nov found no published decision. Large outbreaks in high-income countries meet Watch.
for_you: The NHS advises checking that children and adults have had two doses of the MMR vaccine; GP surgeries can check records. Travellers can see NHS and FCDO advice for destinations with outbreaks.
rubric_hit: Large outbreaks in high-income countries (US ~7,500 cases since 2025) meet Watch; loss of elimination pending PAHO

sources.title: News Tribune (Reuters) — US faces loss of measles-free status as experts meet for review
Healio — States report first measles deaths in decades ahead of PAHO meeting
theGrio — U.S. on the verge of losing measles-free status after 26 years as cases surge

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
